fato_historico: 1775: African-American poet Phillis Wheatley is freed from slavery.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with a vibration of liberation and soulful expansion. Just as powerful words once broke invisible chains to herald a new chapter, you may find your inner voice gaining strength today. It is a good time to release outdated burdens and consider the expansive potential of your spirit as you manifest your true, authentic destiny.
frase_do_dia: Your voice carries the power to unlock doors and create your own sunshine.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of inner wisdom and humanitarian growth.
conselho: Speak your truth with courage and allow your spirit to soar unrestrained.
